title: Real Research Today: Scarless Healing Centers
definition: Today's documented research behind Scarless Healing Centers.
description:
The road to Scarless Healing Centers is already being paved. David Sinclair's Harvard lab demonstrated age reversal in mice via partial cellular reprogramming. The WHO's ICD-11 added an extension code for aging-related conditions, legitimizing the field.

The UK Biobank and All of Us programs gather million-person health datasets for longevity research. Together these programs form the fetal-healing labs foundation that Scarless Healing Centers will build on — the center logistics results, the collagen control methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as center logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Scarless Healing Centers Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Scarless Healing Centers: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Scarless Healing Centers — wound care that heals without any scar.

Phase 1 — Prove (fetal-healing labs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (center logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (collagen control): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (dressing tech): center hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and wound care-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
